# Vitreen Studio

> Done-for-you digital work for contemporary art galleries. Fixed price per task, no retainers, no hourly billing.

Vitreen Studio is a digital studio (an extension of Vitreen) that handles the digital day-to-day work of contemporary art galleries: website updates, collector/artwork database work, sales material and online visibility. Galleries pick a task, see the fixed price upfront, and send what's needed by email — Vitreen confirms scope, does the work, and delivers for review before payment.

Contact: hello@vitreen.studio
Location: Paris, France
Website: https://vitreen.studio/

## How it works

1. Choose a task and send what's needed (text, images, links, exports or access details) by email.
2. Vitreen confirms scope, completes the task and human-checks every detail.
3. Vitreen delivers the finished work by email for review. Payment happens after approval; if the agreed outcome isn't delivered, the task is refunded.

No subscription, no retainer. Works with a gallery's existing tools (current website, Artlogic exports, shared files) — no new software to learn.

## Services and pricing (fixed price per task, EUR)

### Website
- Publish an exhibition — €120 — text, images and dates turned into a published exhibition page.
- Prepare for an opening — €220 — homepage, exhibition and artist pages refreshed and ready before opening.
- Add an artist page — €90 — biography, works, images and basic metadata added to the gallery website.
- Update 10 artworks — €90 — update images, captions, availability or other artwork information.
- Fix a website issue — €90 — investigate and fix one defined issue.

### Database
- Organise your database — €150 — clean categories, fields and structure.
- Import 50 artworks — €220 — clean and import a spreadsheet or export.
- Clean 50 artwork records — €180 — fix inconsistent artwork information.
- Artlogic database check — €120 — find what needs cleaning or reorganising.

### Sales material
- Collector PDF — €80 — a clean, gallery-ready PDF prepared from selected artworks.
- Private viewing room — €120 — a private online artwork selection for a collector.

### Visibility
- Artist SEO check — €120 — find the main SEO issues on an artist page.
- Google indexing — €90 — get new gallery pages discovered and indexed by Google.

## Who it's for

Contemporary art galleries that need digital/web/database work done without hiring in-house or briefing an agency for a retainer. Works alongside a gallery's existing website and tools rather than replacing them.

## Larger projects

For work beyond the fixed-price task list (e.g. a new website build, a full CRM migration), galleries can start a conversation via the "Larger project?" link on the site, which points to the Vitreen Software section.
